mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 60-day forward returns in downturns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP by more than 1% over a quarter signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 60-day forward returns in recessionary periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% over a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 20-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over two months signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased construction activity boosts economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances despite the signal, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure combined with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary period with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% in a month, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 5-day forward returns in tight labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 2% over a month signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending, a key driver of economic growth, contracts.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
